antique furniture: My grandmother's house is full of antique furniture, including a wooden table that is over one hundred years old.
我奶奶家裡擺滿古董傢俱，包括一張超過一百年歷史的木桌。
an antique shop: We found a beautiful old clock in an antique shop on Dihua Street, and it still works perfectly.
我們在迪化街的一家古董店找到一座漂亮的老時鐘，而且它仍然運作得很好。
be anxious about the exam: Mary was so anxious about the exam that she couldn't sleep the night before and kept checking her notes.
瑪莉為考試焦慮到前一晚睡不著，一直翻看她的筆記。
be anxious to please: The new waiter is anxious to please, so he keeps asking customers if they need anything else.
新來的服務生急於討好，所以一直問客人是否還需要什麼。
anxious moments: There were some anxious moments when the plane shook in the storm, but we landed safely in the end.
飛機在暴風雨中搖晃時有過一些焦急的時刻，但我們最後平安降落了。
an anxious wait: After the surgery started, the family had an anxious wait of five hours in the hospital hallway.
手術開始後，家屬在醫院走廊經歷了五個小時焦急的等待。
for no apparent reason: The baby suddenly started crying for no apparent reason, even though he was not hungry or tired.
寶寶沒有明顯的理由就突然開始哭，儘管他既不餓也不累。
It became apparent that…: It became apparent that the new student did not understand Chinese well, so the teacher explained things in English.
新同學不太懂中文這件事變得顯而易見，於是老師改用英文解釋。
an apparent contradiction: There is an apparent contradiction in his story: he said he was home all night, but someone saw him at the store.
他的說法中有個表面上的矛盾：他說整晚都在家，但有人在商店看到他。
appropriate for the occasion: Jeans and T-shirts are not appropriate for the occasion, so please wear a suit to the wedding.
牛仔褲和T恤不適合該場合，所以請穿西裝參加婚禮。
take appropriate action: If you see a fire in the building, you should take appropriate action, such as calling 119 right away.
如果你在大樓裡看到火災，應該採取適當行動，例如立刻打119。
appropriate to one's age: Parents should choose books that are appropriate to their children's age, not ones that are too difficult.
父母應該選擇與孩子年齡相稱的書，而不是太難的書。
where appropriate: Students should use pictures and charts where appropriate to make their reports clearer and more interesting.
學生應在適當的時候使用圖片和圖表，讓報告更清楚、更有趣。
be apt to forget: Old people are apt to forget things, so my grandfather writes notes and sticks them on the fridge.
老年人容易忘記事情，所以我爺爺會寫便條貼在冰箱上。
an apt description: Calling Taipei "a city that never sleeps" is an apt description, since many shops stay open all night.
把台北稱為「不夜城」是個貼切的描述，因為很多商店整夜營業。
an apt pupil: Amy is an apt pupil who learns new piano songs very quickly, and her teacher is proud of her.
艾咪是個聰穎的學生，學新的鋼琴曲非常快，她的老師以她為傲。
an apt remark: At the meeting, the manager made an apt remark that described the problem perfectly, and everyone nodded.
會議上，經理發表了一個恰當的評論，完美地描述了問題，大家都點頭同意。
armed robbery: The two men were arrested for armed robbery after they used guns to steal money from a bank.
這兩名男子用槍搶銀行的錢後，因持械搶劫被逮捕。
the armed forces: My cousin joined the armed forces after high school and now serves as a pilot in the air force.
我表哥高中畢業後加入三軍部隊，現在在空軍擔任飛行員。
be armed with facts: Before meeting the boss, Tina was armed with facts and numbers to prove that her plan would work.
見老闆之前，蒂娜準備了充分的事實和數據作為後盾，以證明她的計畫可行。
an armed conflict: The two countries tried hard to solve the problem through talks, hoping to avoid an armed conflict.
兩國努力透過談判解決問題，希望避免武裝衝突。
armed to the teeth: The soldiers were armed to the teeth, carrying guns, knives, and bombs as they entered the dangerous area.
士兵們全副武裝，帶著槍、刀和炸彈進入危險區域。
an arrogant attitude: He has an arrogant attitude and always thinks he is smarter than everyone, so few classmates like him.
他態度傲慢，總覺得自己比所有人都聰明，所以很少同學喜歡他。
arrogant and dismissive: The famous chef was arrogant and dismissive toward the young cooks, ignoring every idea they suggested.
那位名廚對年輕廚師傲慢且輕蔑，忽視他們提出的每個想法。
an articulate speaker: As an articulate speaker, Jason can explain difficult ideas clearly, so he often represents our class in debates.
身為口齒清晰的演講者，傑森能把困難的概念解釋清楚，所以常代表我們班參加辯論。
be highly articulate: Although she is only ten, she is highly articulate and can express her opinions better than many adults.
雖然她只有十歲，但她極善於表達，表達意見的能力比許多大人還好。
artificial intelligence: Artificial intelligence can now write essays and draw pictures, so some teachers worry that students may stop thinking.
人工智慧現在能寫文章和畫圖，所以有些老師擔心學生可能會停止思考。
an artificial smile: The salesperson gave me an artificial smile, but I could tell she was not really happy to help.
那位店員對我露出假笑，但我看得出她其實並不樂意幫忙。
artificial flavors: This candy contains artificial flavors instead of real fruit, so my mother never lets me buy it.
這種糖果含有人工香料而不是真正的水果，所以我媽媽從不讓我買。
artificial respiration: When the boy stopped breathing in the pool, the lifeguard gave him artificial respiration and saved his life.
男孩在泳池裡停止呼吸時，救生員為他做人工呼吸，救了他一命。
an artificial distinction: Dividing students into "smart" and "stupid" is an artificial distinction that is not based on real facts.
把學生分成「聰明」和「笨」是一種人為的區分，並沒有真正的事實根據。
